g.text: Amu Darya: country withdrawals and allocation limits
Bars = reported actual withdrawals. Vertical ticks = limits. January–December; identical axes.
SIC ICWC yearbooks 2022–2024, §2.1. These are withdrawal accounts, not country river inflows/outflows.
